crossRefs.note: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare…
When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.
Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
Then because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand) they laid Jesus there.
Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to…
and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
“For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against…
to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,
translations.bsb: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and Pharisees assembled before Pilate.
translations.kjv: Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate,
translations.asv: Now on the morrow, which is the day after the Preparation, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together unto Pilate,
